title: Chewy, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-28
summary: Chewy, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 28, 2026, disclosing the execution of a Settlement Agreement and Scheduling Order related to stockholder derivative litigation (Gilbert v. BC Partners LLP, et al., C.A. No. 2024-1165-KSJM) pending in the Delaware Court of Chancery. A settlement hearing is scheduled for June 23, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. The settlement involves the Special Litigation Committee, Chewy, and multiple defendants including private equity firm BC Partners and related entities.
key_points: Settlement Agreement executed April 6, 2026 between the Special Litigation Committee, Chewy, Inc., and defendants including BC Partners LLP and affiliated entities
Court entered Scheduling Order on April 14, 2026 setting settlement hearing for June 23, 2026 at 1:30 p.m.
Case captioned Gilbert v. BC Partners LLP, et al., C.A. No. 2024-1165-KSJM in Delaware Court of Chancery
Settlement Agreement and Settlement Notice attached as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2
Filing signed by Da-Wai Hu, General Counsel & Secretary of Chewy, Inc.
